name: @perch/desktop-sidecar
description: Generic local Playwright runner, bundled into the Perch desktop app as a self-contained binary (Tauri externalBin). Drives an installed browser (detected at startup) or Playwright's Chromium. Tasks: probe / replay / record — connector setup and routines are ProcedureStep lists built on top.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --external:playwright-core --outfile=dist/index.cjs && pkg dist/index.cjs --targets host --output dist/perch-sidecar --config package.json && node scripts/postbuild.mjs
